sop_thesis: **Ridgetech (RDGT)** operates in Consumer Staples (Retail-Drug Stores and Proprietary Stores) with an established market capitalization of $2.60M. The company maintains a confirmed Narrow Moat backed by Everyday Household Brand Trust, Shelf Space Dominance & Global Supply Scale. Long-term valuation metrics model an intrinsic DCF fair value of $0.98 (18.1% margin of safety). Systematic tranche entry is recommended at $0.81 (Tranche 1), $0.76 (Tranche 2), and $0.71 (Tranche 3).
